name: Suggest a source (no PR needed)

**No fork or pull request required.** If you would rather not edit CSV — or would
rather not have your GitHub account associated with a particular ZIP code — this
is the right path. A maintainer will turn it into a row.

**Jurisdiction** (state, county, and city if city-specific):

**What it is** (crime / 311 / permits / assessor / courts / inspections / …):

**URL**:

**Did you fetch it?** (yes/no — an unfetched suggestion is still welcome, it just
gets `status` recorded honestly and a maintainer will verify before merging)

**Anything you learned the hard way** — the most valuable part. A padded field, a
lag, a rolling window, a wrong-jurisdiction lookalike that outranks it in search,
a field that measures something other than its name suggests:

**Anything you could not work out** (how to filter it to a ZIP, whether it
retains history, whether the dates are real dates):
